notes: Medians and every repeat are retained. End-to-end measurements alternate AB/BA order, concurrency one; cold arrays are first calls on fresh clients.
Initial end-to-end: tiny 1000 calls x5, bytes64k 200 x3; before direct Unix writes.
First direct writes: tiny 2000 x5, bytes64k 200 x3; large_sync_regression repeats sync bytes64k 1000 x5.
Final Python: tiny 2000 x5, async bytes64k 500 x5; final_large_sync uses 1000 x5 after restoring ordinary blocking writer handling of queued/large frames.
Batching: 200 calls x5, item-count order alternates; measured before direct-write change.
Go components: three repeats x300ms. FrameDecode ns/op represents 100 in-memory frames. Pipe benchmark is same-process echo, excludes JSON/language runtimes.
Unix socket benchmark skipped: socket creation operation not permitted.
Binary prototype is fixed-schema Python only, omits full protocol semantics and hostile-input validation; it is not shipped as a transport.
Per-request raw latency arrays are omitted; repeat percentiles and cold samples are retained. Shared-machine noise is substantial.
